name: Version 1.10.0
body:
## 📝 Leaner URL-encoded form parsing

Starlette 1.10.0 parses URL-encoded forms with less memory and CPU, no longer drops the last field when a stream ends early, and lets you compare `FormData` that holds several uploads under one key.

```console
uv pip install starlette==1.10.0
```

- **Forms with many fields parse faster and use less memory** ([#3724](https://github.com/Kludex/starlette/pull/3724)). `FormParser` builds each field in the parser callbacks instead of queueing every event and replaying it. On CodSpeed, 1000 fields went from 42.8 ms to 34.9 ms and from 63.5 KB to 54.5 KB, and the `max_fields` limit case went from 6,880 B to 864 B.
- **The last field is kept when the request stream ends without an empty chunk** ([#3599](https://github.com/Kludex/starlette/pull/3599)). The parser is now finalized once the stream is exhausted, so custom streams that never yield a final `b""` no longer lose their last field.
- **`FormData` with repeated uploads can be compared** ([#3619](https://github.com/Kludex/starlette/pull/3619)). Comparing two `FormData` objects with several `UploadFile` values under the same key used to raise `TypeError`.

## ⚠️ Behaviour changes

- **Multidict equality keeps the order of values under a repeated key** ([#3619](https://github.com/Kludex/starlette/pull/3619)). Keys can still appear in any order, but `QueryParams("a=1&a=2")` and `QueryParams("a=2&a=1")` are no longer equal, matching what `getlist()` returns.
- **`starlette.formparsers.FormMessage` is deprecated** ([#3724](https://github.com/Kludex/starlette/pull/3724)). The parser no longer uses it, and `FormParser.messages` is gone. Calling `FormMessage(...)` emits a `StarletteDeprecationWarning`.

## 🧭 Routing and URL generation

- **Path parameter values that look like a placeholder are kept as they are** ([#3725](https://github.com/Kludex/starlette/pull/3725)). `url_path_for("route", category="{id}", id="42")` on `/{category}/{id}` now returns `/{id}/42` instead of `/42/42`. Substitution also got faster, from 549 ns to 520 ns with two parameters and from 1,078 ns to 779 ns with five.
- **Route matching does less work per request** ([#3665](https://github.com/Kludex/starlette/pull/3665), [#3722](https://github.com/Kludex/starlette/pull/3722)). `Match` members are compared by identity, cutting up to 4.9% of the instructions per dispatch in the routing benchmarks.
- **`WSGIMiddleware` strips `root_path` only at a path segment boundary** ([#3718](https://github.com/Kludex/starlette/pull/3718)). A request to `/application` under a `root_path` of `/app` no longer becomes `/lication`.
- **`FloatConvertor` reports NaN and infinity correctly** ([#3716](https://github.com/Kludex/starlette/pull/3716)). NaN was reported as a negative float.

## 🛡️ Middleware, responses and config

- **Handled exceptions no longer keep requests alive** ([#3205](https://github.com/Kludex/starlette/pull/3205)). Starlette clears the traceback after an exception handler runs, so an exception instance reused across requests, such as a module-level `HTTPException`, no longer pins per-request objects in memory.
- **Middlewares accept `http.response.start` without `headers`** ([#3721](https://github.com/Kludex/starlette/pull/3721)). `BaseHTTPMiddleware`, `GZipMiddleware` and `SessionMiddleware` default the omitted field to an empty list instead of raising `KeyError`.
- **`FileResponse` ignores `Range` on methods other than `GET` and `HEAD`** ([#3679](https://github.com/Kludex/starlette/pull/3679)). A `POST` endpoint that returns a file now sends the full file, as RFC 9110 requires.
- **`Config` strips one pair of matching outer quotes from env file values** ([#3720](https://github.com/Kludex/starlette/pull/3720)). `KEY='say "hi"'` now reads as `say "hi"` instead of `say "hi`.

**Full changelog:** [1.9.0...1.10.0](https://github.com/Kludex/starlette/compare/1.9.0...1.10.0)
